source.document: Fluke 8808A Digital Multimeter, Calibration Manual (56 pp.), chapter 3 "Performance Verification and Calibration"
source.pages: printed pp. 3-3 (Table 3-1, required equipment), 3-4 to 3-11 (Tables 3-2 to 3-8 and Figures 3-1 to 3-5); accuracy specifications pp. 1-10 to 1-14
source.cite: Fluke 8808A Calibration Manual, Tables 3-2 to 3-8, pp. 3-4 to 3-11 (limits as printed except the corrections listed in the point flags)
source.limits: Manufacturer limits, 90 days and 1 year, as printed (rounded) in Tables 3-2 to 3-8; typographical errors corrected from the specification formula, see the point flags
source.report_note: Limits are those of the manufacturer's Tables 3-2 to 3-8 (Fluke 8808A Calibration Manual, pp. 3-4 to 3-11), 90-day or 1-year as chosen, as printed (the manual rounds each limit to the printed number of digits). Printed typographical errors were corrected from the manual's own accuracy specification (pp. 1-10 to 1-14); each correction is recorded with the point. Resistance limits are the calibrator setting +/- the printed tolerance.
source.note: Tables 3-2 to 3-8, 105 points: DC volts 17, AC volts 28, 4-wire ohms 6, 2-wire ohms 14, DC current 18, AC current 16, frequency 6 (the zero-offset points of each table are run first, with the input shorted or, for current, open). Limits are the printed 90-day or 1-year limits; several typographical errors in the printed tables were corrected from the specification formula (see the point details). The manual names a Fluke 5700A with a 5725A amplifier and a Fluke 271 function generator; this procedure drives a Fluke 5522A or 5560A. Points the selected calibrator cannot make (5522A: 750 V ac above 10 kHz, 10 A ac at 40 Hz, 1000 kHz; 5560A: 750 V ac above 10 kHz, 1000 kHz) are measured with a standard you connect. The meter must be warmed up for half an hour; the specification is valid in the 5-1/2 digit (slow) rate only.

8808A.name: Fluke 8808A
8808A.model_note: Fluke 8808A 5-1/2 digit bench multimeter, RS-232 only (no IEEE-488, no USB)

sections.title: Zero offset, shorted input
sections.setup: Fit the low-thermal 4-wire short across INPUT HI / LO and SENSE HI / LO (Table 3-1, Fluke PN 2653346). The calibrator is in STANDBY and is not used as a zero source.

sections.title: Zero offset, open current input
sections.setup: Leave the current input (mA terminal, 10 A terminal) OPEN with nothing connected. The calibrator is in STANDBY.

sections.title: 4-wire ohms
sections.setup: Calibrator output to INPUT HI / LO and calibrator SENSE to the meter SENSE 4W HI / LO (Figure 3-2). Calibrator external sense ON.

sections.title: 2-wire ohms
sections.setup: Calibrator output to INPUT HI / LO, sense to INPUT HI / LO (Figure 3-3). Calibrator external sense ON and 2-wire compensation ON.
